title: Surreal Mountain Portal
description: A surreal fantasy landscape features jagged geometric mountains built from teal, orange, and purple block-like structures. Multiple floating oval portals display miniature versions of the same scene, set beneath a cracked orange sun in a pastel sky, all enclosed within a heavily textured painted frame with gold leaf accents.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape with jagged angular mountains constructed from colorful geometric blocks in teal, orange and purple. Several oval portals and spheres float in the foreground showing recursive versions of the mountain scene inside them. A large cracked orange sun hangs in a soft pastel sky with light mist. The entire scene is contained within a thick, heavily textured painterly frame with gold leaf flakes and distressed colorful borders.
